about: Golden set for ContextGapAgent's shared gate (context_gap_gate@v1). Each case is one 30 s window, every speaker as 'Participant N' in order of first speaking. is_gap: the window refers to specific prior context (an earlier decision, meeting, task or discussion) that it does not restate, so a participant who missed it would lack it. For gap cases, keywords are lowercase groups the standalone query must contain ('a|b' = either), i.e. the query names the topic. No-gap cases are mostly windows that DO trip the deterministic detector but are not a gap (a generic phrase, a reference explained in the same window, a plan about the future), plus two that never reach the model. Labels are the maintainer's judgement, written before any model was run against them.
